blocks.raw:
<Tip>
Memorize truss types by span: King Post 5–7 m, Fink 9–15 m, Howe 10–20 m, Pratt 10–25 m. 
In Philippine wind zones, collar ties in the upper 1/3 are recommended for $V > 30\text{ m/s}$ to control lateral thrust.
</Tip>
